commands.name: review
commands.summary: Run 1-5 review-only agents over explicit bounded context and write a consolidated review artifact.

model_tool.name: code_swarm_review
model_tool.description: Run configured CodeSwarm reviewers over explicit bounded review material. First use ordinary tools to retrieve the exact plan, files, or diff to review; then provide that material in context. Reviewers receive context and a concise focus, never ambient session canvas. Returns every reviewer finding plus a consolidated artifact. Use models only for user-named one-off targets. When the result has review_ran false, no reviewer ran: relay its message to the user and do not guess providers or models.

context.description: Required exact review material assembled by the calling agent with ordinary tools (maximum 262144 bytes).

personas.description: Reviewer charter names; defaults rotate correctness, safety, tests.

models.description: One-off provider::model overrides, only when the user named them explicitly.

commands.name: configure
commands.display_name: Configure CodeSwarm reviewers for this project
commands.summary: Pick 1-5 reviewer models for this project's CodeSwarm reviews.

commands.name: configure-user
commands.summary: Pick 1-5 reviewer models as your default for CodeSwarm reviews in every project.

commands.name: import
commands.display_name: Import a legacy CodeSwarm config for this project
commands.summary: Import a legacy .euler/code-swarm.json reviewer config (as JSON input) into this project's config.

commands.name: import-user
commands.display_name: Import a legacy default CodeSwarm config
commands.summary: Import a legacy reviewer config (the code-swarm.json in the Euler home, passed as JSON input) into your default config.
